request.objective: Merge two configuration documents with recursive override semantics and fully independent output data.

requirements.compatibility: Do not modify decoder.py or archive files. Preserve decoder.parse_document behavior. gateway.merge_text must call decoder.parse_document for each input and merging.merge_settings for the parsed documents.
requirements.merge: merging.merge_settings(base, override) requires two dict roots with string keys. Values recursively may be dict with string keys, list, None, bool, int, or finite float/string; reject all other types, non-string keys and NaN/infinite floats anywhere, including overridden values, with ValueError. Recursively merge only where both values are dicts; otherwise override replaces the base value, including explicit None. Keep base-only keys. Return fully independent copies of all nested dicts/lists: do not mutate or retain mutable aliases to either input.
requirements.gateway: gateway.merge_text(base_text, override_text) requires both arguments str. Parse both with existing decoder.parse_document, then merge using merging.merge_settings and return the merged dict. Invalid JSON, non-object documents, non-string arguments and invalid values raise ValueError.
requirements.console: console.main reads exactly two lines from stdin, each a JSON object text, calls gateway.merge_text, and prints json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True) plus newline. Missing either line, invalid input, or any extra non-whitespace input prints ERROR plus newline and returns normally with no stderr or traceback. Ignore whitespace-only trailing input. Standard library only.
